Maple Grove Elementary School
Field Trip Permission Slip

Grade 4 classes will visit the City Natural History Museum on Thursday, April 16, 2026. Students
will leave school at 8:45 a.m. and return by 2:15 p.m.

Trip details
Destination: City Natural History Museum, 400 Harbor Way
Transportation: District school bus
Cost: $12 per student, covers museum admission and a guided program
Lunch: Students should bring a packed lunch and a refillable water bottle. No glass containers.
Dress: Comfortable shoes. Students will walk between exhibit halls.

Supervision
Classroom teachers and four parent chaperones will supervise. Chaperones must complete the
district volunteer process.

What students need to bring
- Packed lunch (no refrigeration available)
- Water bottle
- Weather-appropriate jacket

Permission
I give permission for my child to attend the field trip described above. I understand that the
school will contact me if my child becomes ill or needs medical attention.

Student name: ______________________________
Parent/guardian signature: ______________________________
Date: ______________________________

Return this form and the $12 fee to the classroom teacher by Wednesday, April 8, 2026. Students
without a signed form by that date cannot attend. If the fee is a hardship, contact the office;
assistance is available and is kept confidential.

This form is a synthetic example for testing. The museum, school and dates are fictional.
